title: Luxuriant Jamaican Semolina Wrap
description: A cultured and crunchy Jamaican dish featuring semolina flour, wrapped in a pandan leaf wrap, perfect for a satisfying lunch or snack. This dish is nut-free-friendly, making it accessible to a wide range of diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine semolina flour and water, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook each semolina circle for 1-2 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, saute the diced scotch bonnet peppers, chopped onion, and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the fresh thyme to the pan and stir to combine.
To assemble the wraps, place a cooked semolina circle on a flat surface and spoon the pepper and onion mixture onto the center of the circle.
Fold the bottom half of the semolina circle up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Wrap each semolina wrap in a pandan leaf, securing with a toothpick if needed.
